Some people think durian smells bad, but I love the smell. After collecting the durians, my grandfather sells them at the market. We also give some to our neighbours.

He also tells me stories about animals and nature. He makes every story come alive with his expressions and gestures. I love listening to him. When I grow up, I want to be a storyteller too.
